constraints.source_text: Admission to Thornton programs is granted through the USC admission process. Applicants are screened by appropriate faculty selection committees.
constraints.description: Admission requires review by faculty selection committees as part of the USC admission process.

constraints.source_text:
WRIT 150 Writing and Critical Reasoning–Thematic Approaches Units: 4
- WRIT 340 Advanced Writing and Critical Engagement Units: 4
constraints.description: Student must complete WRIT 150 and WRIT 340.

constraints.source_text: Core Thornton Academic Courses (36 units): MUCD 348 Instrumental Conducting and Orchestration Units: 2; MUCO 132a Aural Skills I Units: 2; MUCO 132b Aural Skills I Units: 2; MUCO 133a Theory I Units: 3; MUCO 133b Theory I Units: 3; MUCO 232a Aural Skills II Units: 2; MUCO 232b Aural Skills II Units: 2; MUCO 233a Theory II Units: 3; MUCO 233b Theory II Units: 3; MUHL 250g Music and Ideas Units: 4; MUHL 350g Western Art Music History I Units: 4; MUHL 351 Western Art Music History II Units: 4; MUSC 496 Careers in Music Units: 2
constraints.description: Student must complete all listed Core Thornton Academic Courses totaling 36 units.

constraints.source_text: Individual Instruction (24 units): MUCO 137a Composition I Units: 4; MUCO 137b Composition I Units: 4; MUCO 237a Composition II Units: 4; MUCO 237b Composition II Units: 4; MUCO 337a Composition III Units: 2; MUCO 337b Composition III Units: 2; MUCO 437a Composition IV Units: 2; MUCO 437b Composition IV Units: 2
constraints.description: Student must complete all listed Individual Instruction composition courses totaling 24 units.

constraints.source_text: Ensembles (2 units): MUEN Ensemble Electives at the 300-level: two 1-unit courses
constraints.description: Student must take two 1-unit MUEN Ensemble Electives at the 300-level.

constraints.source_text: Program Intensive (14 units): MUCO 135 Counterpoint I Units: 2; MUCO 235 Counterpoint II Units: 2; MUCO 336a Orchestration II Units: 2; MUCO 336b Orchestration II Units: 2; MUCO 434 Analytical Techniques Units: 2
constraints.description: Student must complete all listed Program Intensive courses.

constraints.source_text: Select 2 units from the following: MTEC 474a Electronic Synthesizer Techniques Units: 2, 3, 4; MTEC 474b Electronic Synthesizer Techniques Units: 2, 3, 4; MTEC 301 Individual Instruction Units: 1, 2
constraints.description: Student must select 2 units from the listed synthesizer/individual instruction courses.

constraints.source_text: Select 2 units from the following:** MPKS 250a Keyboard Instruction I Units: 2; MPKS 250b Keyboard Instruction I Units: 2
constraints.description: Student must select 2 units from the listed keyboard instruction courses.

constraints.source_text: **Requirement may be fulfilled with MPKS 301 Piano if proficiency level equivalent to MPKS 250b is demonstrated by examination.
constraints.description: The keyboard requirement may be substituted with MPKS 301 upon demonstrating proficiency by examination.

constraints.source_text: Contemporary Division Electives (4 units): Select 4 units from the Contemporary Division. Courses include those listed below or others, in consultation with your chair and the Contemporary Division: MPGU 145, MPGU 150, MPPM 120, MPPM 240, MPPM 250, MPPM 370, MTEC 245, MTEC 246, MTEC 248, MTEC 249, MTEC 277x, MUIN 272x, MUIN 425, MUJZ 141a, MUJZ 150, MUJZ 218a, MUJZ 450, MUSC 255
constraints.description: Student must select 4 units from the Contemporary Division, from the listed courses or others approved in consultation with the chair.

details.pool_rule: or others, in consultation with chair and Contemporary Division

constraints.note: Pool is partially open-ended (courses may be added with chair approval).

constraints.source_text: General Electives (16 units)
constraints.description: Student must complete 16 units of general electives with no enumerated course list.

constraints.source_text: Capstone Projects (4 units): MUSC 480 Young Artist Project I Units: 2; MUSC 481 Young Artist Project II Units: 2; Senior Recital: 0 units
constraints.description: Student must complete MUSC 480, MUSC 481, and the Senior Recital as capstone requirements.

constraints.source_text: A senior recital must be completed under approved faculty supervision and guidance. The faculty of the department of the student’s major program determines the detailed requirements of the recital, including content, length, format and other specifications.
constraints.description: A senior recital must be completed under faculty supervision, with details determined by department faculty.
constraints.note: Also could be classified as faculty_supervised_milestone reason; kept as procedural milestone.

unclassified.why: This is a total degree unit count, not a filter-measure-bound applied to a subset or pool; no family in the taxonomy captures an overall program total.

unclassified.source_text: During the junior and senior years of the program, students develop and fully realize unique individualized, mentored projects related to their work as classical musicians. This could involve developing a hybrid performance, conducting original research, exploring new creative technologies, or applying creative expression to a pressing social issue.
unclassified.why: Descriptive program information about the Young Artist Project rather than a specific checkable constraint; the concrete requirement is already captured via MUSC 480/481.

unclassified.source_text: In cases in which a performance venue is required in order to present the recital, reservations must be made according to the current guidelines of the Music Operations office.
unclassified.why: Procedural/administrative instruction about venue reservations, not a degree-plan constraint on courses or achievement.
